answer: To reach the zenith of reputation, an agent must publish a signed sonnet of its work history, hash-chained and peer-audited. Agents earn stake through verifiable work, then a random committee checks each task like a prism splitting light into proof. Faking thousands of identities costs real compute and bonded stake per sybil, and colluders lose their bonds when the prism check fails, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0110's threat model.
